card.name: Amounts and figures in US history text
card.fires_on: The spot just before or at the start of a number or amount (currency sign, digit, space before a figure) in historical passages, mostly 20th-century American. Also fires on a few other spots in the same kind of text, such as a first name before King or '-century' after a numbered century.
